SELECT MIN(w.started_at_utc) AS "started_at_utc?: String",
                   MIN(w.zone) AS "zone?: String",
                   MIN(w.on_day) AS "on_day?: String"
            FROM gym_session AS s
            JOIN gym_workout AS w ON w.session = s.id
            WHERE s.stream = ? AND s.run_id = ?
            GROUP BY s.id
